The Senate Committee on Ethics offered Bill 214 By: Senators Burns of the following substitute to SB 214: 23rd, Williams of the 25th, Moore of the 53rd, Harbin of the 16th, Gooch of the 51st and others AS PASSED SENATE
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 2 of Title 21 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to elections and primaries generally, so as to provide for new voting equipment by the state … to imprisonment for not less than one nor more than ten years or to pay a fine not to exceed $100,000.00, or both."
SECTION 12. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
